This leaf is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in heaths, scrublands, and moors, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

The pulp extracted from the leaves is spread over burns or minor cuts. It doubles the natural healing rate of these injuries and additionally restores about five concussion hits when used on burns. Its straightforward application makes it useful to travellers with no access to specialised care.
